Plot PCA results using ggplot2

Source: R/utils-internal.R
dot-plot_pca.Rd

Internal function that creates a PCA plot using ggplot2 with optional coloring, labeling, clustering ellipses, and customizable color palettes.

Usage

.plot_pca(
  pca_df,
  group_col,
  circle_size,
  label_replicates,
  sample_colors,
  show_clusters,
  color_vals,
  pca
)

Arguments

pca_df

A data frame of PCA coordinates and metadata (from .prepare_pca_dataframe()).

group_col

Column name used for grouping/coloring samples.

circle_size

Point size for the scatter plot.

label_replicates

Logical; whether to display sample labels.

sample_colors

Logical; whether to color by group.

show_clusters

Logical; whether to draw ellipses for group clusters.

color_vals

Named color vector for groups.

pca

Original PCA object used to compute variance explained for axis labels.

Value

A ggplot2 object.
